label: D1 after a reward, while the agent leans toward a2, late in the episode (trials ~45-88)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never at GO or D2), and almost only when the reward input is 1 (98% of mass). It needs the agent to lean toward a2: 99.99% of activations come before an a2 choice, and all of them have the D1 policy logit in [-4.4, -1.5]. It also depends on time in the episode: it is silent before trial ~40 and after trial ~90 and peaks at trials 60-80, with model value in the 5.2-7.5 band. Within a run of rewarded a2 trials, magnitude climbs with each extra consecutive reward (e.g. 0.75 -> 0.78 -> 0.80 -> 0.83). It is weak or absent right after an unrewarded trial two back. It does not fire after unrewarded trials, before a1 choices, or early in the episode. The recorded predicate uses only observed quantities: the reward input, the model own D1 policy logit (choice < 0) instead of the upcoming action, the reward two trials back (!= 0, which also passes the first trial of the window), and episode position. Using the upcoming action (action == 2) instead gives nearly identical dev F1 (0.767 vs 0.775). Simpler versions score lower: D1 & rewarded & a2 (dev F1 0.44, mass recall 0.98) and adding the trial 45-88 band (dev F1 0.72). Precision stays incomplete: the feature fires in some episodes and not others under the same pattern, likely a slow, episode-level state.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=D1 & choice_bin=decile 4 (9 = most a1) (+3.88), phase=D1 & choice_bin=decile 3 (9 = most a1) (+3.85), phase=D1 & before=a2 S2 r (+3.17), choice_bin=decile 4 (9 = most a1) (+3.13), choice_bin=decile 3 (9 = most a1) (+2.64), phase=D1 & rel=-2 (+2.53).
